Trained on ~48T tokens using FP8 mixed precision with post-training incorporating SFT, large-scale agentic RL, and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Delivers strong performance on reasoning, coding, math, and complex multi-step agentic tasks.

models.name: GLM-5.2
models.description: Open-weight MoE model with 753B total parameters (40B active) and a 1M token context window - 5× larger than GLM-5.1. Features IndexShare architecture reducing per-token FLOPs by 2.9× at 1M context and dual reasoning effort modes (High and Max). Top open-source model on SWE-bench Pro (62.1) and Terminal-Bench 2.1 (81.0). MIT licensed open-source.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813
models.description: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 is the GA release of DeepSeek's flagship reasoning model, a Mixture-of-Experts system with 1.6T total parameters and 49B active per token. It pairs Compressed Sparse Attention with Heavily Compressed Attention, cutting single-token inference compute to ~27% and KV cache to ~10% of the V3.2 generation at the 1M-token setting. Released under the MIT license with open weights.

models.name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL
models.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is an open multimodal model for long-running agents that need to see, reason, and act. It combines text, image, document and GUI understanding with agentic reasoning and tool use in one model. Built on a 121B-parameter MoE architecture (512 routed experts, ~12B active per token) pairing a hybrid Mamba-2/Attention NemotronH backbone with a RADIO v2.5-H vision encoder, with multi-token prediction and NVFP4 optimization.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Diarization
models.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Diarization is an open, streaming speaker diarization model for multi-party voice applications. Built on the Streaming Sortformer lineage, it assigns live speaker labels and timestamps for up to eight speaker slots in one stream. Because it operates alongside transcription, developers can pair it with Nemotron ASR, Parakeet, Canary, Whisper, or another ASR system without replacing their existing workflow. Supports meetings, contact-center conferences, clinical conversations, live captioning, and multi-party voice agents.

models.name: Qwen3 TTS
models.description: A 1.7B-parameter text-to-speech model covering 10 languages Hugging Face with remarkably low latency.
